title: Functionality Guide
text: Point isoreader2 folder discover data files inside . generic ir_find_isofiles() finds supported types, ir_find_continuous_flow(), ir_find_dual_inlet(), ir_find_scans() narrow search specific measurement types. bundled example files available via ir_examples_folder().
code: # path to your data folder (here the local copy of the example files) data_folder <- file.path("tmp")  # find continuous flow files (.dxf/.cf) in the folder file_paths <- data_folder |> ir_find_continuous_flow()  # show what was found file_paths [1] "tmp/continuous_flow_ea_example.dxf" "tmp/continuous_flow_gc_example.cf"

title: Functionality Guide
text: Read discovered files. returns ir_isofiles object - tibble one row per file extracted datasets stored nested columns.
code: # read the files isofiles <- file_paths |> ir_read_isofiles() → Trying to install isoextract for your operating system isoextract-linux-x64   (this requires an internet connection and may take a moment)... ✔ [1.4s] check_assembly() successfully installed isoextract version 0.2.1.0  ✔ [189ms] ir_extract_isofiles() finished extracting 2 files/archives  ✔ [494ms] ir_read_isofiles() finished reading 2 isotope data files/archives # show what was read isofiles ─────── 2 isofiles with 2 analyses - combine with ir_aggregate_isofiles() ────── 1. continuous_flow_ea_example.dxf: with 1.1k time points for N2 (masses 28, 29, and 30); 1.34k time points for CO2 (masses 44, 45, and 46); 20 metadata columns 2. continuous_flow_gc_example.cf:   with 8.6k time points for HD (masses 2 and 3); 19 metadata columns

title: Functionality Guide
text: Multiple ir_isofiles collections can combined one simple c(), row-binds preserving object type.
code: # combine two collections (here just the same files twice for illustration) c(isofiles, isofiles) ─────── 4 isofiles with 4 analyses - combine with ir_aggregate_isofiles() ────── 1. continuous_flow_ea_example.dxf: with 1.1k time points for N2 (masses 28, 29, and 30); 1.34k time points for CO2 (masses 44, 45, and 46); 20 metadata columns 2. continuous_flow_gc_example.cf:   with 8.6k time points for HD (masses 2 and 3); 19 metadata columns 3. continuous_flow_ea_example.dxf: with 1.1k time points for N2 (masses 28, 29, and 30); 1.34k time points for CO2 (masses 44, 45, and 46); 20 metadata columns 4. continuous_flow_gc_example.cf:   with 8.6k time points for HD (masses 2 and 3); 19 metadata columns

title: Functionality Guide
text: can store entire ir_isofiles collection disk (RDS file) read back exactly , without re-reading original data files.
code: # save and reload the read isofiles isofiles |> ir_save_isofiles(file.path("tmp", "my_isofiles")) ✔ [47ms] ir_save_isofiles() saved 2 isofiles to tmp/my_isofiles.rds reloaded <- ir_load_isofiles(file.path("tmp", "my_isofiles")) ✔ [6ms] ir_load_isofiles() loaded 2 isofiles from tmp/my_isofiles.rds
